tspan.tspan: The Nifty’s 10.1% fall is mild by past standards
How far the Nifty 50 stood below its highest close so far, each trading day since 2007.
Source: NSE via Yahoo Finance; Zerodha calculations
Daily closes of the price index, so dividends are not counted.
The line shows how far the Nifty stood below its highest close so far. Zero means a
new high; the deeper the dip, the bigger the fall.
